mainEntity.name: What is involved in implementing a GOE strategy for a contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementing a GOE strategy for a contractor involves several key steps. It begins with comprehensive keyword research to identify what potential clients are searching for. Then, on-page optimization focuses on improving your website's content, structure, and technical aspects. Off-page activities include building high-quality backlinks and managing local business listings. Regular content creation, performance monitoring, and adjustments based on analytics are also crucial for sustained success.
acceptedAnswer.description: Implementing a GOE strategy involves keyword research, on-page website optimization, off-page activities like link building and local listings, content creation, and ongoing performance monitoring.
